description: This file contains functions for analyzing and summarizing operator coverage in PyTorch models using inductor decompositions, including graph extraction, operator counting, and CSV report generation.

methods.name: fwd_bwd_compiler
methods.description: Appends a given FX graph to the global graphs list and returns a boxed version of the graph.

methods.name: get_inductor_decomp_graphs
methods.description: Generates forward and backward computation graphs of a model with inductor decompositions using tracing and AOT compilation.

methods.name: print_op_coverage_summary
methods.description: Prints a tabulated summary of operator coverage in a model, optionally saving the results to a CSV file.
